debugData.name: Leaf litter
debugData.description: ambientCG LeafSet024 (CC0, ambientcg.com/view?id=LeafSet024): nine beech leaves, its colour with its opacity as A (source/leafLitter_albedo.png, devTools/toolkit/buildLeafLitter.ts), a cell each (leaf0-leaf8, the 3 × 3 grid cut at 340 and 684 px). Alpha coverage kept at 0.5 down the mips (the leafLitter material's alphaTest), so distant cards don't thin out; FULL mip chain: past the levels the 4 px padding keeps apart, the leaves' transparent surroundings mix. For the toolkit's leaf cards (p308 D5).
